verdict.rationale: The Inso CLI gives programmatic access to a narrow slice of Insomnia: running collection tests and linting specs in CI, with prompts disabled and exit codes. Git Sync also keeps project data as files in your own repository. There is no evidence of a public API covering UI functionality: OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and import is documented only as a UI flow. Missing for 10: a documented public API, programmatic control of collections, environments, mock servers, imports and org/RBAC management, and evidence of UI-to-API parity.
